# GS-014: Release and recapture ammonia inside one closed system
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 NH4Cl 0.001mol
seal v1 100mL
measure v1 pressure
add v1 NaOH 0.001mol
measure v1 ph
measure v1 pressure
inspect v1
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
measure v1 ph
measure v1 pressure
inspect
